mechanism: Etanercept (TNF-alpha inhibitor) may increase infection risk and immunosuppression while lisdexamfetamine causes CNS stimulation; combined use increases risk of opportunistic infections and cardiovascular stress during stimulant therapy.
action: Monitor closely for signs of infection during concurrent use; ensure appropriate prophylaxis for opportunistic infections and obtain baseline cardiac assessment before initiating lisdexamfetamine in patients on etanercept.
